newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Metals - Aluminium demand up, others quiet.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Metals - Aluminium demand up, others quiet.

text.p: Some scattered aluminium buying interest was seen in the South Korean market this week despite a rise in domestic prices in line with recent gains on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said on Thursday.
But other LME metals were quiet in lacklustre trading, reflecting the slowdown in the economy.

Taihan Electric Wire Co Ltd, South Korea's leading cable maker and second largest aluminium rolling mill, has agreed one-year purchasing contracts for 1,000 tonnes of aluminium a month with Canada's Alcan and an Australian supplier, they said.

LG Metals Corp, a unit of LG Group and South Korea's largest copper producer, last Monday posted a domestic selling price of 2.297 million won a tonne for March, compared to 2.279 million a month ago.
Korea Zinc, South Korea's largest zinc and lead producer, posted a monthly domestic zinc selling price of 1.187 million won a tonne, up from 1.15 million won a month ago.
But Korea Zinc's monthly lead price fell to 703,000 won a tonne from 728,000 won.
